verdict.rationale: TeamViewer ships AI features, including Tia, session summaries and an AI troubleshooting assistant, so an AI-training privacy control is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documented opt-out or setting that keeps customer data out of model training. The only related claim is that Tia 'learns from every support session', which describes using session data rather than a way to prevent it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
